behaviorMatrix.firstResponse: Three main HTTP relays have once-only response/failure settlement. Start each 10000ms timer only after remoteHosts.request resolves with the ClientRequest, therefore after SSH setup. Clear on response or request error; drain late responses; destroy on timeout. This is response-header/first-byte timeout, never stream idle timeout. Request send/end and abort handling remain policy callbacks.
behaviorMatrix.rawApi: Known-down breaker short-circuits before dialing; every transport failure supplies classified reason to noteTransportFailure then JSON502. HTTP statuses including401/404/500 do not trip breaker. Raw request bytes pipe upstream, raw response pipes downstream, SSE flushes headers and remains uncompressed. Only small artifact creation/revocation JSON is interpreted.
behaviorMatrix.publicArtifact: Local publication lookup wins. Require token mapping, correct kind and configured remote. Only allowlisted public request headers plus identity encoding and optional annotate-off are forwarded. Public failure is plain502 with no breaker feedback or error classification. Unknown mappings bare404 without probes. Owner document404 prunes exact host mapping; asset404 does not. Slash404 checks bare document before redirect/prune.
behaviorMatrix.comments: After parsed JSON/auth middleware. Query/body/target pageToken precedence and local-page wins retained. Missing mapping/remote calls next. JSON reserialization and64Ki UTF16-character response bound remain distinct from artifact overflow-to-streaming. Empty body becomes{}. Failure JSON includes classified reason but no breaker feedback.
behaviorMatrix.safeResponseHeaders: API/public primary responses have identical Object.entries loop: reject existing hop-by-hop table and access-control-*; preserve all other keys/value arrays and native setHeader behavior. Do not apply to comment responses, outgoing request policies or WS handshake.
behaviorMatrix.artifactJson: Only actual2xx JSON creation/revocation hooks update mappings and rewrite public URL.64Ki-character limit overflows to raw relay; malformed JSON passes through; hook failure retains body. Content-Length removed for intercepted JSON; no broad body parser or DTO.
behaviorMatrix.websocket: Untouched upgrade authorization, peer credential, raw head/socket splice, peer refusal status, no first-response helper or new WS timeout
behaviorMatrix.nativeErrors: remoteHosts.errorCode remains actual producer of classified/opaque reasons for API/comment errors; public failures do not inspect error objects. No new validation/coercion/catch policy. Timer destroy catches and response stream error handling retain original scope.
